dedupe_keys.name: wms nrw de earthquake hazard datasets

description: wms.nrw.de: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.nrw.de. Coverage: the area served by wms.nrw.de. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: EAS NRW WMS - Seismologische Stationen in Nordrhein-Westfalen (Erdbebe; Karte der Erdbebenzonen in Nordrhein-Westfalen - WebMapService (WMS); Seiskat NRW WMS - Katalog der Erdbebenereignisse in Nordrhein-Westfale; Seismik NRW WMS - Seismische Untersuchungen in Nordrhein-Westfalen - D. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – Version 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
